# Empty

What a region shows when it loaded and has nothing: why, and what to do next.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Accessible first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Accessible first:** An empty list, saying what will appear and how to start. Not while loading, and never a blank page.

- **Use it when:** An empty list, a search with no results, or a first visit with no items yet.
- **Not when:** Still loading (skeleton or spinner), or a load that failed (alert).

Instead:

- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md): Still loading.
- [Alert](./alert.md): Something went wrong.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An empty state</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Explain what will appear here and how to start</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A blank page</div></div><div class="cap">A blank page leaves people unsure if something failed. Example: “You have no saved applications. Start a new one below.”</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Empty looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Empty, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-human-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What must the interface protect?</b><code>human.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Low effort to understand</div><p>Low effort to understand each step.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: The brand stays out of the way: words say what will appear and how to start.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Empty decisions would reopen</small><p>and 15 answers that follow from it: <b>Calm and clear</b>, <b>Quiet</b>, <b>Core: heading, body, label</b>, and 12 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What icon style?</b><code>iconography.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Filled</div><p>Filled icons stay visible at low vision.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>icon</b>: A filled icon in a tile, beside words that say what will appear here and how to start.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add empty
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Empty reads 15 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Empty's tokens to change Empty alone.
